_note: Per-rifle handling. Art: assets/weapons/v3 (weapon kit v3, modular). All fire the shared 'ammo' item. damage is per hit before zone multiplier (old single rifle = 100). cycle_s = time before the next shot. spread = multiplier on the shared hip/aim cone. noise = multiplier on NoiseBus.RADIUS_GUNSHOT. optic = sight on the receiver: type scope (black tube picture, model hidden) | tube_dot (wide tube, red dot) | reflex (model stays, red dot) | iron (model stays); mag = fixed [m] or variable [min, max] true magnification vs the 70 deg hip view; the mouse wheel steps only variable scopes; reticle = duplex | bdc (first-focal-plane holdover for 200/300/400 m from the real ballistics) | dot | none. mag = rounds before a reload. reload = magazine | single. v3 rifles (weapon kit v3, modular): 'v3': true, 'mounts' = what the rifle can take (optic rail|bases|scout|none, light barrel|none), 'factory' = attachments it is found with, 'irons' = the built-in sight used when no optic is fitted. Their sight comes from the fitted optic in data/attachments.json (RifleDB.optic), not from an 'optic' block. action = bolt | semi | lever (drives the viewmodel cycle). mounts.mount = adapter slot (scout_clamp), mounts.muzzle = thread | none. rimfire: moderators work better.

timber_bolt_carbine.name: Timber Scout Carbine
timber_bolt_carbine.desc: Short camo-dipped bolt carbine with a forward 2x scout scope. Quick to the shoulder; five rounds.

ranger_box_rifle.name: Ranger Hunting Rifle
ranger_box_rifle.desc: Walnut bolt-action deer rifle under a 4x scope. Four heavy rounds; the hunter's choice.

frontier_vented_rifle.name: Frontier Semi Carbine
frontier_vented_rifle.desc: SKS-type self-loader in red hardwood with a red-dot tube on the cover rail. Five rounds, quick follow-ups.

ridge_scout_rifle.name: Ridge Varmint Rifle
ridge_scout_rifle.desc: Heavy stainless barrel in grey laminate under a 3-9x scope with holdover marks. Threaded muzzle; no iron sights.

brush_lever_rifle.name: Brush Lever Carbine
brush_lever_rifle.desc: Walnut lever carbine with a tube magazine and buckhorn sights. Six rounds fed one at a time.

north_service_rifle.name: North Service Rifle
north_service_rifle.desc: Surplus military bolt rifle in old birch. Ten rounds, a fast bolt and an aperture sight; takes a clamp-on scout mount.

compact_patrol_rifle.name: Compact Rimfire Carbine
compact_patrol_rifle.desc: Light .22 rimfire carbine with a birch stock, a micro reflex sight and a barrel-clamp light. Ten quiet rounds; aim for the head.

expedition_rifle.name: Expedition Magnum
expedition_rifle.desc: Black synthetic magnum with a ported brake and a 4-12x scope. Four devastating, very loud rounds.
